## PM command reference

- **Refresh**: `./out/qed_dashboard && git add DASHBOARD.md && git commit -m 'dashboard: refresh' && git push`
- **Per-agent paste**: `cat AGENT<N>_WORK.md`
- **Send mail**: write `mail/a<N>/from_pm_c<CYCLE>_<subject>.md`; commit + push
- **Auto-escalate**: `./out/qed_auto_escalate` (fires mail for stale P0s)
- **MVC API** (via running vibepoint): `curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7777/ -d '{...rest_dispatch...}'` — see `tools/vibepoint/routes.c`
